title: market_data/weekly/{date}/constituents.json
description: Pinned CONSUMER copy, owned by crucible-executor (alpha-engine-config-I10796 / data_collection_plan_260914.md P-27). Producer: nousergon-data collectors/constituents.py::collect() (S&P 500 + S&P 400 membership). crucible-executor's read path (executor/eod_reconcile.py::_load_constituents_sector_map, shared by executor/signal_reader.py::patch_unknown_sectors_with_constituents on the pre-open path) consumes only `sector_map`, but the full producer shape is pinned here so a schema change anywhere in the object is caught, not only in the one field read today. RECONCILED 2026-09-14 against the producer's own nousergon-data/contracts/constituents.schema.json (P-07, nousergon-data-PR1711, 2ef120fb), which now exists. A byte-verbatim copy of it is kept at tests/contracts/producer/constituents.schema.json and the two are held in agreement by tests/test_contract_producer_parity.py — nothing this file marks required is absent from the producer's contract, and a producer-conformant document validates here. The two remain SEPARATE files by design: the producer's is additionalProperties:false and models the write path, this one is additionalProperties:true and records which field the trader's read path consumes. A producer schema-version bump is a cross-repo PR per data_collection_plan_260914.md §4.3 with this side merged first.

date.description: the weekly run_date this snapshot was written under

sp500_tickers.description: present only when sp500_count + sp400_count == len(tickers) (config-I6946); omitted otherwise rather than sliced on a count that doesn't describe the list

sector_map.description: ticker -> GICS sector name. THE field crucible-executor reads (_load_constituents_sector_map: `data.get('sector_map', {})`).

fetched_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch
